negative_reviews.author: Mathilde P
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) The ramen wasn't bad and the portions were decent, but it didn't have the flavors of authentic Japanese ramen. Even though I ordered a mild ramen, there was still a little bit of chili in the broth.
The waitress was nonchalant, and when it came time to pay, she handed me the card machine directly, without showing me the receipt and making sure I didn't see the amount. I didn't appreciate this, especially since a 10% tip had been automatically added to the bill, which I felt was undeserved.

(Original)
Le ramen n'est pas mauvais et les portions sont correctes, mais ce n'est pas les saveurs des vrais ramen japonais. Bien qu'ayant pris un ramen sans piment, il y en avait quand même  un petit peu dans le bouillon.
La serveuse était non chalante et au moment de payer elle m'a directement tendu l'appareil à carte bancaire, sans me présenter le ticket et en faisant tout pour que je ne vois pas le montant inscrit. Je n'ai pas apprécié cette façon de faire, surtout qu'un pourboire de 10% avait été rajouté d'office sur l'addition et n'était à mes yeux pas mérité.

negative_reviews.author: xiaoqiang liu
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) I took my family out to eat, and one of the Indian waitresses kept coming over to ask about our dining experience and clearing away the plates, which made me very uncomfortable. I felt like she was trying to drive us away, but the other customers weren't treated the same way.

(Original)
带家人一起去吃饭，其中一个印度女服务员，不停的过来问用餐体验，并且来回收拾盘子，让我很不舒服，感觉在驱赶顾客，但是其他人并没有这样被对待。

negative_reviews.author: Stacy Paris
negative_reviews.text: (Monday 4/5 17:30-18:00)  The food was great. The service however was utterly abysmal. The girl serving had her face tripping her the entire time and was incredibly rude and neither staff looked like they could be bothered to serve customers, absolutely no customer service in sight, yet we're quite happy to walk over to the kitchen and chat and laugh audibly. The place wasn't welcoming at all and it ruined the entire experience for us and lets the place down.
